description: Full length portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe standing to the side of road in the New Mexican landscape looking to the right while in the act of shooting a photograph with her Leica camera. She is wearing light colored clothing with her signature black Stetson hat.  Rolling hills dotted with Juniper bushes loom in the horizon along with several cars traveling down the road into the distance.
title: Untitled, Georgia O'Keeffe
